title: Plugin Guard
idle.meta: Scan a plugin before you install it
scanning.title: Scanning
empty.title: No plugin scanned yet
empty.body: Paste a plugin's git URL and press Enter. Plugin Guard clones it into /tmp and reads the code without running any of it. Add the commit the marketplace verified to see what changed since.
error.invalid-url: That is not a git URL
error.hint: Check the address and your connection, then scan again.
error.emptyUrl: Enter a git URL, for example https://github.com/user/plugin.git
diff.failed: Could not compare with the verified commit
meta.head: HEAD %1
install.head: Install HEAD %1
install.question: Install %1 at commit %2?
install.warningDanger: This scan found high-risk patterns. Install only if you have read the code.
install.next: Enable it with: omarchy plugin enable %1
tooltip.idle: Plugin Guard: no plugin scanned yet
scanning.note: Nothing from the repository is run
